verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is a hosted AI app-building platform, so offering registrable outbound webhooks for platform events is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no such capability. GitHub commit sync, the Stripe payment integration, MCP connectors and Supabase edge functions are adjacent features or building blocks, not webhook subscriptions the product itself provides, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
